headline: Southern Thailand: Mossad was named in two capitals. No case we checked puts Israel there.
context: Anwar told the Dewan Rakyat in 2025 that Mossad targets Malaysia. Sondhi Limthongkul wrote it to Israel's ambassador on 10 September. We checked a dozen documented cases naming Israel in Thailand and Malaysia since 2012.

changes.summary: Correction: we now paraphrase the Kelantan police statement of 2 August rather than quote wording we could not confirm, describe Malaysia's RM3.04 billion border works as walls and fences, describe the conflict's aim only as self-rule, give the budget and death toll as our listed sources report them, and say Bangkok pointed to a putative sanctuary in Malaysia rather than to Malaysia itself.

cards.big: Sondhi Limthongkul's 10 September letter to Israel's ambassador says Mossad spies sit 'scattered' across Thailand. Anwar told Parliament in 2025 that Mossad targets Malaysia.
cards.sub: Neither mentioned the Deep South. Nor does any case we checked, from Fadi al-Batsh's 2018 killing to Pattaya's nominee files.

cards.big: Iranians jailed in Bangkok in 2013 over bombs police said targeted Israeli diplomats. Shalom Avitan jailed in KL in 2025 over six guns meant, he said, for a rival Israeli.
cards.sub: Israel's embassy counts 41 Thai workers killed on 7 October 2023. Thailand's Foreign Ministry counted 32 that month.

cards.big: Sihasak Phuangketkeow said on 27 July Bangkok would ask Malaysia to deny insurgents safe haven. Kelantan police, 2 August: no evidence suspects fled into Kelantan.
cards.sub: Bangkok's foreign hand is a putative sanctuary across the Golok, not Israel. Malaysia's RM3.04 billion walls and fences are due by 2029.

cards.big: Fourth Army chief Norathip Poinok called the 51 attacks of 22 August possible retaliation for his sweeps and an 18.7 million baht cash seizure, pending evidence.
cards.sub: Crisis Group in 2017: nationalists, 'no evidence of jihadist inroads'. Prachatai reported the BRN posted 'Patani-Palestine: Unite' in 2023.

cards.big: The Deep South needs no imported villain. It has a 22-year fight over self-rule, 340 billion baht in Thai budgets, and nearly 6,000 certified dead.
Like blaming a stranger three streets away for the fire while the neighbour is at the door and the wiring report sits unread.
Every case we checked puts Israel in Bangkok, Pattaya, Phuket or Kuala Lumpur. The foreign hand Bangkok named this year is an unproven sanctuary in Malaysia.
